proof_summary: Take the composite number \(n=23492890653051=3\cdot37\cdot43\cdot42307\cdot116341\), whose displayed factors are prime. Multiplicativity of the Pillai gcd-sum gives \(\sum_{k=1}^n\gcd(k,n)=\prod_{p\mid n}(2p-1)=610815156979325\), and this sum plus one equals \(26n\), so its gcd with \(n\) is \(n\) and the resulting quotient is \(1\).
